faq.intro: Answers to the questions we hear most often. Have another one? Reach out — we reply fast.

items.a: It depends on the project. We chat on the phone to pin down your needs before giving you a clear price.

items.q: How much of my time will it take?
items.a: It depends on the project, but for simple projects, count on less than 5 days.

items.q: I have no copy, photos, or logo.
items.a: No problem — it’s actually the most common situation. For copy, we guide you at every step. For photos, we have access to professional image libraries and AI tools to generate custom ones. And for the logo, we can help you create it, from concept to final result.

items.q: I already have a website, but it’s weak. Do you rebuild it?
items.a: Yes — it’s actually a good part of what we do. We look at what’s there, keep what works, and optimize the rest.

items.q: Will the site be in both French and English?
items.a: Yes, all our sites are built bilingual by default, to reach your entire customer base.

items.q: How will my customers reach me or book a meeting?
items.a: They can send a request right on the site, or reach you by email, phone, or social media to schedule a consultation with you.

items.q: Will I be able to manage my blog myself?
items.a: Yes, you can manage your blog yourself. Or we can also handle it for you as a service.

items.q: Will the site rank well on Google?
items.a: We structure every site to SEO best practices (speed, mobile, local content). Final ranking also depends on factors we don’t control — but we start from a strong base.

final.subtitle: One call is enough to know whether we can help. No pressure, no jargon.
